content.short: K3 Capital is an on-chain asset and risk manager curating DeFi lending vaults.
content.description: K3 Capital has managed non-directional DeFi strategies since 2021, concentrating on interest-rate arbitrage, liquidity provisioning and early-stage protocol participation. Its clients are crypto-native institutions and high-net-worth investors, and it states the TVL across projects it has built or curated. The firm's positions extend to Hyperliquid and Monad.
content.meta: Sets the collateral policy behind lending vaults that depositors allocate into.
